q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. I live with my parents and my little sister. I really like my maths teacher, Mr Chen, because he explains things clearly and he often tells funny stories in class. I use my mobile phone every day, but only for about an hour, because I have a lot of homework. I like spring the most, because the weather is warm and the flowers in the park are beautiful. I prefer the morning, because I feel fresh and I can concentrate better. I like football and table tennis – I play football with my friends every Saturday. I usually listen to pop music, especially when I’m doing my homework. In the school holidays I visit my grandparents in the countryside, read books and sometimes go on trips with my family.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子回答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, every Saturday），能正确使用一般现在时、频率副词和比较级等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see a classroom. There is a teacher and some students. The teacher is a man with short dark hair. He’s wearing a blue shirt and a tie, and he’s leaning over the desk and looking at a student’s book. Maybe he’s checking her work or helping her. There are four students sitting at the desks. They’re writing in their notebooks. One girl with long fair hair is smiling, so I think she’s happy with her work. Behind them there are big windows, so the room looks bright. On the desks I can see books, pens and some yellow paper. I think they’re having a lesson, perhaps an English or a history lesson, and it looks like a friendly class.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要涵盖人物（是谁、在做什么、穿什么）、地点和其他物品，并用 I think / maybe / perhaps / it looks like 进行合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think chess is a good idea, because it can take a long time and it makes you think. But not everybody in the family can play it. Listening to music is relaxing, but you’re right, they can’t talk to each other, so it isn’t very fun for a family. Taking photos is great – you can see mountains and rivers from the train, and you can keep the photos to remember the trip. I’m not sure about the film. The laptop is small, and it might be difficult for four people to watch together. I agree, playing the guitar is fun, but it could be too noisy on a train. Other passengers might be angry. Having a picnic is a good idea too, because everyone gets hungry on a long journey. In my opinion, the picnic would be the most fun, because the whole family can eat and chat together. So shall we choose the picnic? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每个观点（同意或不同意并说明理由），主动谈到其他活动，用 I think / In my opinion / I’m not sure about… / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最有趣的活动。

q4.sampleAnswer: I don’t go on long journeys very often, maybe twice a year, because I’m busy with school. My favourite way to travel is by train, because it’s comfortable and I can look out of the window. In the future I’d most like to travel to Australia, because I want to see kangaroos and the beautiful beaches. The best place I’ve visited in my country is Guilin. The mountains and the river were really beautiful, and we went on a boat trip. I think it’s better to have a holiday in your own country, because it’s cheaper and you don’t need to worry about the language. But going abroad is exciting too, because you can learn about a different culture.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题表明观点并给出理由或具体经历，用一般过去时讲述去过的地方，用 would like to 谈愿望，用 because / but 展开，必要时可回应 What do you think? 等追问。
